capabilities: Convert pasted links from supported services into embed blocks
Embed local PDF, video, and audio files via wikilinks or paths
Toggle click-to-load mode that defers iframe loading behind preview cards
Customize per-block height, aspect ratio, and load mode
Convert links under cursor or selections to embeds via commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Pasting external media links into Obsidian leaves plain URLs, and building embed blocks manually or embedding local media of many formats is fiddly.

relations.evidence: Paste a link from Spotify, YouTube, Google Drive, Vimeo, Loom, Figma, SoundCloud, Twitch, CodePen
YouTube: Videos, playlists, shorts, live streams, embeds, timestamps.

summary: Paste-based embed tool that converts Spotify, YouTube, and other service links, plus local PDF, video, and audio files, into embedded players in notes.
